_about: ONE case table for what places a report image, read by BOTH sides: backend tests/test_report_image_placement.py (report_images.referenced_ids / code_spans) and frontend src/tests/utils/reportImages.test.ts + src/tests/components/SafeMarkdown.test.tsx (utils/reportImages.ts referencedImageIds / codeSpans, and the preview). The editor's preview shows placements while the author types, so the client keeps its own reader; this file is what keeps the two from drifting (review 2026-10-01 M1, 2026-10-02 H5; backlog 2026-10-22, H-d). Add a case here, never to one side. The second half of `references` are spellings pandoc reads as an image: they are not placements (the preview shows none, the report prints none there) until `normalise_references` has rewritten them on save. Offsets in `code_spans` are character positions; keep the texts ASCII.
